summary: Roughly a third of the ground-truth menu grammar matches: the session/workspace right-click menus have the right items in the right order, and the permissions menu's SOURCE has the right icon+desc+eyebrow+check shape. But two whole menus from the prototype's grammar family are effectively absent from the app (the 'mode' execute/plan popover doesn't exist at all despite a fully-built backend behind it; the model picker is a flat single-column Select standing in for a two-pane provider/model/thinking widget), the shared ContextMenu kit component has no separator primitive at all (so both destructive items lose their visual break), the active-item check renders in the wrong accent color kit-wide, and 'remove workspace' fires its DELETE immediately with no confirmation step the prototype requires. A live DOM dump also proved the deployed preview bundle is stale for composer menus (bare-text buttons, no icon/desc/eyebrow) and Rail's context menu (a stale 6-item 'Rename/Fork/Export/Share/Pin/Delete' set that doesn't exist anywhere in current source) — source was used as the authority per instructions, but both need a fresh build to confirm visually.

items.element: Permissions/approval popover — eyebrow header + option list (composer footer 'ask' pill)
items.proto_truth: Panel eyebrow text node 'permissions' (CSS text-transform:uppercase, JetBrains Mono 10.5px, letter-spacing .1em, color var(--t-mu,#6b7280)). 4 rows, each icon(14px col)+name(12px mono #c5cad3)+desc(10.5px mono #6b7280)+check(14px col, teal): ask/'Prompt me before every tool call', auto-edits/'Auto-approve safe file edits; ask for the rest', auto/'Auto-approve every action (use with care)', bypass/'Skip permissions entirely'. Verified live at design/prototype/Clio Session.html (popApprove block, ~byte-offset 7949105) and screenshot apps/web/screenshots/visual-check/proto-ask-menu.png.
items.fix_hint: Content divergence is DELIBERATE and documented (Composer.tsx:17-21 comment): the app's 4 values are the real backend Literal, not the prototype's placeholder 'auto'. That's a correct grounding call, not a bug — but the prototype's copy for the 3 shared values should stay verbatim (it does), and 'ai-review' needs its own description reconciled with backend semantics if it isn't already user-facing copy elsewhere.

items.proto_truth: Check icon on the active row explicitly colored teal: `color:var(--t-cy,#0aa6ad)` in both the approve and mode popover templates (design/prototype/Clio Session.html, ~offsets 7949105 and 8459004). Confirmed visually teal in apps/web/screenshots/visual-check/proto-ask-menu.png (checkmark next to 'ask').
items.fix_hint: Kit ContextMenu's check uses --t-ac (orange accent, #c4682a) instead of --t-cy (teal, #0aa6ad). One-line CSS fix, but it's kit-wide so it silently mis-colors every menu that uses `checked` (permissions menu, and Rail's workspace-pin checkmark once that's fixed too).

items.proto_truth: A real dropdown, same grammar as permissions: eyebrow 'mode', 2 rows — execute/'Act on the workspace under the permission mode' (checked, teal check), plan/'Read-only — plan changes, never apply'. design/prototype/Clio Session.html popMode block (~offset 8459004+3400). Captured live: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/proto-mode-menu.png.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx:15 (`export type ComposerMode = 'ask' | 'execute';` — no 'plan' member anywhere) and :348-357 (the 'execute' control is a plain `<button>` that unconditionally calls `setMode('execute')` — no popover, no options, no descriptions). `grep -r "'plan'" apps/web/src` returns nothing.
items.backend_surface: PATCH /v1/sessions/{id} body.mode — Literal['plan','edit','architect'] (clio-agent src/clio_agent/gact/types.py:440,461,476), backed by a full plan-mode lifecycle module (clio-agent src/clio_agent/gact/plan_mode.py: plan-file path computation, per-turn reminder injection, playbook transition to execution).
items.fix_hint: This is not cosmetic — the backend has a complete, real plan-mode feature with no UI entry point at all. Note the vocabulary itself needs reconciling too: prototype says execute/plan, backend Literal is plan/edit/architect (no 'execute' value exists server-side), and the app's current 'ask'/'execute' ComposerMode type conflates this axis with something else entirely (its 'ask' click is wired to the approval button, not a real mode).

items.element: Provider/model picker popover (composer footer model selector)
items.proto_truth: Two-column widget, ~480px wide, resizable both dimensions. Header: eyebrow 'providers' + gear icon ('Provider settings'). Left column: one row per provider (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Codex, Claude Code, ALCF Sophia, ALCF Metis, vLLM) each showing name + a 'default ⌄' per-provider config picker + a color-coded status label (ready / no key / signed out / offline). Right column: models of the selected provider, each with a gear icon opening a per-model sampling-parameter editor ('saved per model on this provider'), active model shown in teal name-color + teal check. Footer row: eyebrow 'thinking' + effort chips (default/off/low/medium/high). Captured live: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/proto-router-menu.png (source: design/prototype/Clio Session.html popRouter block).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/Select.tsx (generic single-column Popover+listbox) used at apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx:361-370; app-side visual: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/app-03-model-menu.png (flat list, rows pre-joined as 'Provider (detail) / model')
items.fix_hint: Functionally works (pick a provider+model, it PATCHes) but none of the grammar survives: no eyebrow, no two-pane provider/model split, no status-per-provider, no gear/settings affordance, no sampling-param editor, no thinking-effort row. Active option is shown via text color (--t-cy) rather than the kit's check icon (select.css:60-62), which is itself a second, independent way of marking 'active' that diverges from ContextMenu's checked pattern — the kit has two different active-item conventions.

items.element: Session row context menu — items, order, danger tone
items.proto_truth: 200px flat panel, icon+label only (no description, no eyebrow): pin/unpin (label toggles), rename, [separator], delete (red #f87171). design/prototype/Clio Session.html ctxOpen block (~offset 8093200). Screenshot: apps/web/screenshots/visual-check/proto-session-menu.png.
items.backend_surface: PATCH /v1/sessions/{id} (rename), DELETE /v1/sessions/{id} (delete) — per Rail.tsx:73-74 method annotations; pin is client:true (UI-only)

items.proto_truth: Both the session ctx menu and workspace ctx menu insert a `<div style="border-top:1px solid var(--t-bd3,...); margin:4px 4px;">` between the safe actions and the destructive one (design/prototype/Clio Session.html, both ctxOpen and wsCtxOpen blocks).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/ContextMenu.tsx:5-15 (MenuItemDef has no `separator` field) and apps/web/src/kit/contextmenu.css (no divider rule exists anywhere in the file)
items.fix_hint: Kit-wide gap, not a per-usage bug — every ContextMenu consumer that needs to set a destructive item apart (session ctx, workspace ctx) currently relies on color alone. Add a `{ id, type: 'separator' }` item kind to MenuItemDef and render the prototype's hairline.

items.element: Workspace context menu — 'pin workspace' label + active indicator
items.proto_truth: Label text itself toggles: 'pin workspace' ↔ 'unpin workspace' (wsCtxPinLabel, design/prototype/Clio Session.html ~offset 8425160). No check-icon column exists on this flat menu at all — same grammar as the session ctx menu (icon+label only).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Rail.tsx:221-229 — label is the hardcoded string `'pin workspace'` (never flips to 'unpin workspace'); instead sets `checked: menuGroup?.pinned`, which renders a check-icon column this menu's ground truth doesn't have
items.backend_surface: UI-owned (client:true equivalent; no PATCH call for pin observed)
items.fix_hint: Flip the label like the session menu's ctxPinLabel does (Rail.tsx:206 already does this correctly for sessions — same pattern isn't applied to the workspace item at :224), and drop `checked` here since the ground-truth workspace menu has no check-icon slot.

items.element: Workspace context menu — separator before 'remove workspace'
items.proto_truth: Same hairline separator as the session menu, between 'new session here' and 'remove workspace' (design/prototype/Clio Session.html wsCtxOpen block, ~offset 8103534).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Rail.tsx:221-259 (workspaceItems array, no separator entry — same kit gap as the session menu finding above)
items.fix_hint: Same fix as the session-menu separator finding — one kit change covers both.

items.element: 'remove workspace' — confirmation step before the destructive call
items.proto_truth: Selecting 'remove workspace' does NOT delete immediately — it opens a confirmation modal: 'remove workspace' header (red, warning icon) + body text 'Remove "{name}" and its {N} session(s) from the sidebar?' with cancel/confirm actions (design/prototype/Clio Session.html wsConfirmOpen block, ~offset 8104304).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx:542-559 (`handleWorkspaceAction`: on action==='remove' it calls `void client.deleteWorkspace(workspaceId)` directly inside the ContextMenu's onSelect handler — no intermediate confirm dialog/state)
items.fix_hint: Highest-severity item in this surface: a single misclick on a context-menu row now permanently unregisters a workspace with no undo prompt, where the ground truth explicitly gates it. Add the confirmation modal (or reuse Layer/Popover kit primitives) before calling deleteWorkspace.

items.element: Session row context menu — deployed preview bundle freshness
items.app_evidence: Live capture of the running preview at localhost:4191 (apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/app-04-session-ctx.png) shows a 6-item menu — Rename, Fork, Export, Share, Pin, Delete — that does not exist anywhere in current source (`grep -rn "Fork\|Export\|Share"` in apps/web/src finds no such menu item list; current SESSION_ACTIONS in Rail.tsx:61-75 has exactly 3 items: pin, rename, delete).
items.fix_hint: Confirms the task brief's caveat generally, not just for composer files — the deployed preview is stale for Rail's context menu too. Treat apps/web/src as authoritative until a fresh build is captured.
